docs.keyboard: Tab moves focus to it; Enter or Space activates it. Announced as its label and “button”.
docs.notFor: Navigation (use a link) or toggling a setting (use a checkbox).
docs.purpose: Lets people take an action: save, continue, delete.
docs.usage: One Primary per view, for the main action. Secondary for the rest, Tertiary and Plain for low emphasis, Critical for destructive actions. Label with a verb.

docs.keyboard: Tab moves focus to it; Enter or Space activates it. Announced as its label and “button”.
docs.notFor: Actions whose icon isn’t obvious: use a Button with a label.
docs.purpose: An action shown as an icon, where space is tight and the icon is well known.
docs.usage: Always give it an accessible label (Inspect → Accessibility); add a Tooltip with the same words.

docs.keyboard: Tab moves focus to it; typing edits it. Its label and help text are announced; an error is announced when it appears.
docs.notFor: Choosing from known options (use Select, Radio button or Checkbox).
docs.purpose: Lets people enter text: names, emails, amounts.
docs.usage: A short label above, a hint below. Show errors under the field, in the Error state, saying how to fix it.

docs.keyboard: Tab moves focus to it; Space or Enter opens the list; arrows choose; Escape closes it.
docs.notFor: Two to five options (use Radio button) or several choices (use Checkbox).
docs.purpose: Lets people choose one option from a list.
docs.usage: Order options logically (alphabetically, or by how often they’re used). Give it a label.

docs.keyboard: Tab moves focus to it; Space checks or unchecks it.
docs.notFor: One choice among several (use Radio button).
docs.purpose: Turns an option on or off, independently of others.
docs.usage: Phrase labels positively. Indeterminate is for a parent whose children are partly checked.

docs.keyboard: Tab moves focus to the group; arrows move the selection.
docs.notFor: A single on/off option (use Checkbox) or long lists (use Select).
docs.purpose: Lets people choose exactly one of a few options.
docs.usage: Show two to five options in a column, with a sensible one selected.

docs.keyboard: Not focusable; read with the content it describes.
docs.notFor: Actions (badges aren’t clickable) or long text.
docs.purpose: Shows a short status: Paid, Draft, Needs review.
docs.usage: One or two words. Choose the tone by meaning: Success for done, Caution and Warning for attention, Critical for problems.

docs.keyboard: Not focusable itself; its title is announced when it appears.
docs.notFor: Confirmations of small actions (use a toast) or permanent content.
docs.purpose: Tells people about something important on the page: a problem, a success, a change.
docs.usage: A title that says what happened, a body that says what to do. Use the tone that matches the urgency.

docs.keyboard: Not focusable; its alternative text is the person’s name.
docs.purpose: Represents a person or a store with initials or a picture.
docs.usage: Small in dense lists, Medium beside a name, Large on a profile. Pair it with the name.

docs.keyboard: Arrows move between tabs; Enter or Space selects one.
docs.purpose: One view in a set of Tabs.
docs.usage: Short labels. Exactly one is Selected.

docs.keyboard: Tab moves focus into the tabs; arrows move between them.
docs.notFor: Steps in a process or actions.
docs.purpose: Switches between views of the same content, like order statuses.
docs.usage: Up to about five tabs, with short labels, and the first selected.

docs.keyboard: Focus moves into it when it opens and stays there; Escape closes it; focus returns to what opened it.
docs.notFor: Information people need while working (keep it on the page).
docs.purpose: Asks people to confirm or finish something before going on.
docs.usage: A specific title, the consequence in the body, and the action that does it as the button label.

optics-body-23.name: Body
optics-body-23.default: This can’t be undone. The product will be removed from every sales channel.

children.name: Body
children.text: This can’t be undone. The product will be removed from every sales channel.

docs.keyboard: Shown while its control has focus; Escape hides it.
docs.purpose: Names a control or adds a short hint on hover and focus.
docs.usage: A few words. Always shown on keyboard focus too, not only on hover.

docs.notFor: Progress you can measure (use a progress bar).
docs.usage: One spinner for the area that’s loading, with text saying what.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Lead with one primary action, with secondary ones beside it.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Put two primary buttons side by side: nobody can tell which matters.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use icons everyone knows, and name the action for screen readers.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use an icon nobody can guess: give it a label in a Button instead.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Give every field a visible label and helpful hint.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Repeat the label as a placeholder: it adds nothing and disappears when typing.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use a select for a long list of known options.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use a select for two options: radio buttons show both at once.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use checkboxes for options people can turn on independently.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Phrase options negatively: people have to work out what checking means.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Offer two to five options where exactly one applies.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use a single radio button: it can’t be turned off again.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use a badge for a short status next to what it describes.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Stack many tones together: the colors stop meaning anything.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Say what happened and what to do next, in the right tone.

propValues.optics-body-17: Update your card to keep your plan.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use a banner for something that isn’t news: it trains people to ignore banners.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Group related content and its actions in one card.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Split one task across several cards: keep it together.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Pair an avatar with the person’s name.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Mix avatar sizes in one list.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use tabs to switch between views of the same content.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use tabs for actions: use buttons.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Confirm a destructive action with a clear title and the button that does it.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Ask a vague question: say exactly what will happen.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Use a tooltip to name an icon-only control.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Put essential information in a tooltip: touch screens can’t hover.

propValues.optics-text-24: Orders over $50 ship free, except to remote areas.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Show a spinner with what’s loading.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Show several spinners at once: show one for the area that’s loading.
